description: The single switch for the diff nets added by the safety-net plan (docs/rules/safety-evidence.md#diff-nets). While 'blocking' is false every net listed here reports its findings in the job summary and annotations but exits 0, so pilot numbers can be reviewed before anything blocks a merge. Set 'blocking' to true (one reviewed change) to make all of them fail their job on findings. Scripts accept --advisory/--blocking to override locally.
